plan.purpose: Fresh held-out test of the exploratory direct-path correction on the original fp32 checkpoint, after seeing the original primary validation results.
plan.primary_comparison: At block 22, gamma 0.9, compare direct-path plus zero-prior ridge correction against training-fitted two-coefficient scalar transport, using the paired 95 percent interval for held-out R2 difference. Also report the difference from scaled identity and all declared cells. Keep the original primary training examples and five-fold penalty selection fixed. A nonpositive or inconclusive result is retained.
plan.bootstrap: 2000 draws over 64 source/donor pairs. No test-set tuning.
plan.final_block: Report analytic scaled identity as a check; R2 on the theoretically zero remainder is undefined.
